objectives.description: Git-backed target: confirm newly-copied untracked file appears in completion notice
Non-git target: confirm sync completes cleanly with no git error and no untracked section
Tracked-file case: confirm a git-added copy file is excluded from the untracked list
Confirm existing category counts, .syncprotect protection, and merge re-injection unchanged
Lint/style check: no line >100 cols, 2-space indent, no tabs in added lines (luacheck unavailable)

approaches_tried.approach: Intercept vim.notify directly to capture completion messages in headless harness
approaches_tried.reason: helpers.notify passes level strings ("INFO"/"WARN") that don't match any key in notify.categories, so category resolution falls back to STATUS (debug_only) and vim.notify is never invoked outside debug mode -- a pre-existing, unrelated quirk in the notification system, not caused by this change

deviations.description: Test harness intercepts helpers.notify directly instead of vim.notify
deviations.reason: vim.notify interception found zero captured messages because helpers.notify's level strings do not match any notify.categories key, causing an unrelated pre-existing category fallback to a debug_only category; intercepting helpers.notify directly captures the exact string sync.lua constructs, which is what this task's verification needs.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- intercepted helpers.notify instead of vim.notify due to pre-existing debug_only category fallback)*
